The 'FRONT (XZ)' view shows the elevation (X width, Z height). The Z-axis represents the vertical height of the part, with the base at Z=0 and the top at Z=50.

edit_rules: Changing the base rectangle width (40) or depth (30) updates the bottom profile of the loft.
Changing the top circle diameter (Ø20) updates the top profile of the loft.
Changing the total height (50) updates the Z-position of the top profile and the loft length.
The XY center of both profiles must remain aligned at (0,0).
